summary: The US-Iran conflict intensified this week as the US carried out a fifth consecutive day of strikes, with Iran responding by attacking US bases in Kuwait, Jordan, and Bahrain. Brent crude climbed back above $85 a barrel as energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz continued to slow, reviving concerns about tighter global markets.
tweet: Middle East escalation is spiking oil and rattling long bonds, while a cooler June CPI print slashed July Fed hike odds to 17% — leaving markets torn between inflation risk and policy relief.
